officialText:
As a condition of license renewal, a licensed master electrician shall provide evidence satisfactory to the department that such licensee is fit to perform the work.

(L.L. 2024/128, 12/21/2024, eff. 12/21/2025)

Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2024/128.

Article 430: Special Electrician License
